description: Coordinate composition: a static diagonal green gradient.
prompt: Write a GLSL ES 3.0 fragment shader implementing mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord). iResolution (vec3) and iTime (float) are provided; do not redeclare them and do not write main(). Requirements: (1) brightness must increase both from left to right and from bottom to top, producing a diagonal gradient; (2) the result must be predominantly green; (3) it must not change with iTime; (4) no NaN or fully black output.
